change.title: Automate the TestFlight alpha handoff
change.summary: Moves alpha iOS builds from local scripts to a checked-in Xcode Cloud project, with GitHub Actions verifying and tagging exact commits. It also limits alpha backend changes to guarded experimental APIs and makes App Store submission require an exact eligible build.
change.why: The change appears to make release handoffs repeatable, keep build inputs tied to immutable commits, and prevent internal-only or unintended builds from reaching App Store review.
highlights: Adds a gated GitHub Actions flow that verifies `next`, deploys allowed backend changes, and creates an immutable alpha tag.
Checks in the Expo iOS workspace, dependencies, signing settings, and Xcode Cloud setup scripts.
Adds server-side email guards for experimental Convex APIs.
Removes local alpha and beta build flows; store submission now requires an exact version and build number.
risks: The release path now depends on GitHub Actions, Xcode Cloud settings, repository secrets, and tag triggers matching the checked-in assumptions.
The checked-in iOS project can drift from Expo configuration or JavaScript dependencies despite the new drift check.
Alpha handoff deploys the production backend before it creates the Xcode Cloud tag; a later tag or cloud-build failure leaves that deploy in place.

summary.title: Restrict local workflow to store submission
summary.what: Removes local alpha and external beta workflows and keeps one App Store submission workflow. The remaining flow requires an exact version and build, checks its audience, validates the App Store version, and gates submission with `CONFIRM=1`.
summary.why: This appears to prevent latest-build fallbacks and block internal-only alpha builds from App Store review.
details: Requires both `VERSION` and `BUILD_NUMBER`.
Requires exactly one matching build.
Rejects builds unless their audience is `APP_STORE_ELIGIBLE`.
Defaults to a dry run unless `CONFIRM=1`.
risks: The build and version lookup depend on the shown `asc` response shapes.
Validation occurs before the build is attached in the submit command, so some build-specific faults may surface only during submission.

summary.title: Remove manual release workflows
summary.what: Deletes the manual-signing build, upload, and distribution workflows.
summary.why: This appears to retire local iOS release paths in favor of the new cloud handoff.
risks: Any caller that still invokes these workflow names will fail.

summary.title: Add experimental tester allowlist
summary.what: Documents `EXPERIMENTAL_TESTER_EMAILS` as a deployment-only, comma-separated list of app-user emails.
summary.why: It supplies the server-side access list for guarded experimental Convex APIs.
details: An unset value is documented to deny all experimental calls.
risks: Wrong or stale email values can deny intended testers or grant the wrong account access.

summary.title: Register iOS drift check
summary.what: Adds the iOS configuration drift checker as a Fallow entry point.
summary.why: The script is called by release and cloud setup paths that static imports cannot find.

files.patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/release-alpha.yml b/.github/workflows/release-alpha.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a56a161
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/release-alpha.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,137 @@
+name: Alpha Handoff
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - next
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      sha:
+        description: Full commit SHA to hand off to Xcode Cloud
+        required: false
+        type: string
+
+# Keep every started handoff alive. A queued push rechecks next before it can
+# deploy or create a tag, so old work stops safely without canceling a deploy.
+concurrency:
+  group: alpha-handoff
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  handoff:
+    name: Verify and hand off immutable alpha commit
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || vars.ALPHA_AUTOMATION_ENABLED == 'true'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: write
+    env:
+      EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
+      SELECTED_SHA: ${{ inputs.sha || github.sha }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out selected commit
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ inputs.sha || github.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Fetch release branches
+        run: |
+          git fetch --no-tags origin \
+            +refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main \
+            +refs/heads/next:refs/remotes/origin/next
+
+      - name: Check immutable commit before verification
+        id: preflight
+        run: |
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SELECTED_SHA"
+          result="$(node scripts/release-handoff.mjs validate \
+            --sha "$SELECTED_SHA" \
+            --branch origin/next \
+            --event "$EVENT_NAME" \
+            --base origin/main)"
+          printf '%s\n' "$result"
+          printf 'status=%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$result" | jq -r '.status')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Explain skipped handoff
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'skipped'
+        run: echo 'The selected commit contains [skip alpha]; no release handoff ran.'
+
+      - name: Explain stale push
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'stale'
+        run: echo 'This queued push is no longer the origin/next tip; no release handoff ran.'
+
+      - name: Set up pnpm
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'ready'
+        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
+
+      - name: Set up Node.js
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'ready'
+        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 24
+          cache: pnpm
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'ready'
+        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+
+      - name: Verify selected commit
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'ready'
+        env:
+          TURBO_SCM_BASE: origin/main
+          TURBO_SCM_HEAD: HEAD
+          UDO_VERIFY_BASE_REF: origin/main
+        run: pnpm verify:ci
+
+      # The queued job may have verified an old next commit while a newer push
+      # arrived. Check again immediately before every production mutation.
+      - name: Recheck immutable commit before deployment
+        id: ready
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'ready'
+        run: |
+          git fetch --no-tags origin \
+            +refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main \
+            +refs/heads/next:refs/remotes/origin/next
+          result="$(node scripts/release-handoff.mjs validate \
+            --sha "$SELECTED_SHA" \
+            --branch origin/next \
+            --event "$EVENT_NAME" \
+            --base origin/main)"
+          printf '%s\n' "$result"
+          printf 'status=%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$result" | jq -r '.status')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Explain handoff that went stale during verification
+        if: steps.ready.outputs.status == 'stale'
+        run: echo 'A newer next push arrived during verification; no release handoff ran.'
+
+      - name: Check immutable tag
+        id: tag
+        if: steps.ready.outputs.status == 'ready'
+        run: |
+          tag_name="alpha/${SELECTED_SHA}"
+          existing="$(git ls-remote --refs origin "refs/tags/${tag_name}")"
+          if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
+            existing_sha="${existing%%$'\t'*}"
+            if [ "$existing_sha" != "$SELECTED_SHA" ]; then
+              echo "Refusing to reuse ${tag_name}: it points at ${existing_sha}, not ${SELECTED_SHA}." >&2
+              exit 1
+            fi
+            echo "${tag_name} already exists; its Xcode Cloud handoff is complete."
+            echo 'create=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          else
+            echo 'create=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          fi
+
+      - name: Deploy safe backend to production
+        if: steps.ready.outputs.status == 'ready' && steps.tag.outputs.create == 'true'
+        env:
+          CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY }}
+        run: pnpm --filter @packages/backend exec convex deploy
+
+      - name: Create immutable Xcode Cloud tag
+        if: steps.ready.outputs.status == 'ready' && steps.tag.outputs.create == 'true'
+        run: |
+          tag_name="alpha/${SELECTED_SHA}"
+          git -c tag.gpgSign=false tag "$tag_name" "$SELECTED_SHA"
+          git push origin "refs/tags/${tag_name}"
+          echo "Created ${tag_name}; Xcode Cloud now owns the build handoff."

+      SELECTED_SHA: ${{ inputs.sha || github.sha }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out selected commit
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ inputs.sha || github.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Fetch release branches
+        run: |
+          git fetch --no-tags origin \
+            +refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main \
+            +refs/heads/next:refs/remotes/origin/next
+
+      - name: Check immutable commit before verification
+        id: preflight
+        run: |
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SELECTED_SHA"
+          result="$(node scripts/release-handoff.mjs validate \
+            --sha "$SELECTED_SHA" \
+            --branch origin/next \
+            --event "$EVENT_NAME" \
+            --base origin/main)"
+          printf '%s\n' "$result"
+          printf 'status=%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$result" | jq -r '.status')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Explain skipped handoff
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'skipped'
+        run: echo 'The selected commit contains [skip alpha]; no release handoff ran.'
+
+      - name: Explain stale push
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'stale'
+        run: echo 'This queued push is no longer the origin/next tip; no release handoff ran.'
+
+      - name: Set up pnpm
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'ready'
+        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
+
+      - name: Set up Node.js
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'ready'
+        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 24
+          cache: pnpm
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'ready'
+        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+
+      - name: Verify selected commit
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'ready'
+        env:
+          TURBO_SCM_BASE: origin/main
+          TURBO_SCM_HEAD: HEAD
+          UDO_VERIFY_BASE_REF: origin/main
+        run: pnpm verify:ci
+
+      # The queued job may have verified an old next commit while a newer push
+      # arrived. Check again immediately before every production mutation.
+      - name: Recheck immutable commit before deployment
+        id: ready
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'ready'
+        run: |
+          git fetch --no-tags origin \
+            +refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main \
+            +refs/heads/next:refs/remotes/origin/next
+          result="$(node scripts/release-handoff.mjs validate \
+            --sha "$SELECTED_SHA" \
+            --branch origin/next \
+            --event "$EVENT_NAME" \
+            --base origin/main)"
+          printf '%s\n' "$result"
+          printf 'status=%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$result" | jq -r '.status')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Explain handoff that went stale during verification
+        if: steps.ready.outputs.status == 'stale'
+        run: echo 'A newer next push arrived during verification; no release handoff ran.'
+
+      - name: Check immutable tag
+        id: tag
+        if: steps.ready.outputs.status == 'ready'
+        run: |
+          tag_name="alpha/${SELECTED_SHA}"
+          existing="$(git ls-remote --refs origin "refs/tags/${tag_name}")"
+          if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
+            existing_sha="${existing%%$'\t'*}"
+            if [ "$existing_sha" != "$SELECTED_SHA" ]; then
+              echo "Refusing to reuse ${tag_name}: it points at ${existing_sha}, not ${SELECTED_SHA}." >&2
+              exit 1
+            fi
+            echo "${tag_name} already exists; its Xcode Cloud handoff is complete."
+            echo 'create=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          else
+            echo 'create=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          fi
+
+      - name: Deploy safe backend to production
+        if: steps.ready.outputs.status == 'ready' && steps.tag.outputs.create == 'true'
+        env:
+          CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY }}
+        run: pnpm --filter @packages/backend exec convex deploy
+
+      - name: Create immutable Xcode Cloud tag
+        if: steps.ready.outputs.status == 'ready' && steps.tag.outputs.create == 'true'
+        run: |
+          tag_name="alpha/${SELECTED_SHA}"
+          git -c tag.gpgSign=false tag "$tag_name" "$SELECTED_SHA"
+          git push origin "refs/tags/${tag_name}"
+          echo "Created ${tag_name}; Xcode Cloud now owns the build handoff."

summary.title: Add immutable alpha handoff
summary.what: Adds a gated workflow for `next` pushes and manual dispatches. It verifies an exact commit, rechecks branch freshness, deploys permitted backend changes, and creates an `alpha/<sha>` tag for Xcode Cloud.
summary.why: This appears to automate alpha handoff while avoiding mutable branch-tip builds and stale queued releases.
details: Keeps concurrent runs queued instead of canceling work in progress.
Honors `[skip alpha]` and skips stale pushes.
Runs `pnpm verify:ci` against `main`.
Reuses an existing matching tag without redeploying.
risks: The production backend deploy happens before tag creation, so tag failure can split the handoff.
A manual dispatch may select an older commit reachable from `next`.
The workflow needs write access and a valid production Convex deploy key.

diff --git a/apps/frontend/docs/AUTOMATIC_CODE_SIGNING.md b/apps/frontend/docs/AUTOMATIC_CODE_SIGNING.md
deleted file mode 100644
index 0c84636..0000000
--- a/apps/frontend/docs/AUTOMATIC_CODE_SIGNING.md
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,207 +0,0 @@
-# Automated Code Signing for U Do
-
-This guide explains how to set up automated code signing for command line builds.
-
-## Current State: Manual Signing ✅
-
-Your project currently uses **manual code signing** which works fine. The provisioning profile UUID is hardcoded in:
-
-- `apps/frontend/ios/ExportOptions.plist`
-- `.asc/workflow.json`
-
-**Pros:**
-
-- Works reliably
-- Full control over signing
-
-**Cons:**
-
-- Must manually download new provisioning profiles when they expire
-- Profile UUID must be updated in config files
-
-## Upgrade to: Automatic Signing 🚀
-
-Automatic signing uses your App Store Connect API key to automatically download the correct certificates and provisioning profiles during the build.
-
-**Pros:**
-
-- No manual profile management
-- Automatic profile updates
-- Better for CI/CD automation
-- No hardcoded UUIDs
-
-**Cons:**
-
-- Requires ASC API key setup (one-time)
-- Slightly slower first build (downloads profiles)
-
-## Setup Instructions
-
-### Prerequisites
-
-You need an App Store Connect API key:
-
-1. Go to [App Store Connect → Users and Access → Keys](https://appstoreconnect.apple.com/access/integrations/api)
-2. Generate a new API key (or use existing one)
-3. Download the `.p8` key file
-4. Place it in your project root directory
-
-### Step 1: Get Your Issuer ID
-
-1. Go to [App Store Connect → Users and Access → Keys](https://appstoreconnect.apple.com/access/integrations/api)
-2. Click on **"App Store Connect API"** tab
-3. Copy the **Issuer ID** from the top of the page
-   - It looks like: `12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc`
-
-### Step 2: Run Setup Script
-
-```bash
-./scripts/setup-automatic-signing.sh
-```
-
-The script will:
-
-- Find your API key file (`AuthKey_*.p8`)
-- Extract the Key ID from the filename
-- Ask for your Issuer ID
-- Create `.env.codesign` with your credentials
-
-### Step 3: Verify Setup
-
-```bash
-# Load the environment
-source .env.codesign
-
-# Test with dry run
-asc workflow run release-beta-auto --file .asc/workflow-automatic.json --dry-run
-```
-
-### Step 4: Use Automatic Signing
-
-**Option A: Using npm script (recommended - inline)**
-
-```bash
-pnpm release:beta
-```
-
-**Option B: Using wrapper script**
-
-```bash
-./scripts/release-beta-auto.sh
-```
-
-**Option C: Manual inline**
-
-```bash
-source .env.codesign && asc workflow run release-beta-auto --file .asc/workflow-automatic.json
-```
-
-**Option D: Using asc directly**
-
-```bash
-# First source the env
-source .env.codesign
-
-# Then run any asc command with those credentials
-asc workflow run release-beta-auto --file .asc/workflow-automatic.json --dry-run
-```
-
-## Configuration Files
-
-After setup, you'll have:
-
-1. **`.env.codesign`** - Environment variables with your API credentials
-2. **`apps/frontend/ExportOptions-Automatic.plist`** - Export config for automatic signing. This lives **outside** the git-ignored `ios/` directory and is version-controlled, so `expo prebuild --clean` can't delete it. The workflow's `export_ipa` step references it as `../ExportOptions-Automatic.plist` (relative to `ios/`).
-3. **`.asc/workflow-automatic.json`** - Workflow using automatic signing
-
-> **One-time keychain authorization.** The `archive` step signs the embedded frameworks locally with your **Apple Development** certificate, whose private key lives in your login keychain. The first time `codesign` touches that key it triggers a GUI "Allow" dialog — and a headless `pnpm release:beta` run will **hang forever** waiting on it. Authorize `codesign` once so it never prompts:
->
-> ```bash
-> security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple:,codesign: -s -k "<login-keychain-password>" ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db
-> ```
->
-> (Or run an archive interactively once and click **"Always Allow"** on the dialog.)
-
-## How It Works
-
-With automatic signing, `xcodebuild` will:
-
-1. Connect to Apple using your API key
-2. Download the correct signing certificate
-3. Download/generate the provisioning profile
-4. Sign the app automatically
-5. No manual intervention needed!
-
-## API Key Details
-
-You need three pieces of information:
-
-- **Key File**: `AuthKey_*.p8` (downloaded from App Store Connect, placed in project root)
-- **Key ID**: Extracted from filename (e.g., `AuthKey_ABC123.p8` → Key ID is `ABC123`)
-- **Issuer ID**: From App Store Connect API page
-
-## Quick Comparison
-
-| Feature            | Manual Signing      | Automatic Signing     |
-| ------------------ | ------------------- | --------------------- |
-| Setup complexity   | ✅ Simple           | ⚠️ One-time setup     |
-| Profile management | ⚠️ Manual           | ✅ Automatic          |
-| CI/CD friendly     | ⚠️ Needs profiles   | ✅ Self-contained     |
-| Profile expiration | ⚠️ Must update UUID | ✅ Auto-updates       |
-| Build speed        | ✅ Fast             | ⚠️ Slower first build |
-
-## Troubleshooting
-
-### "API key file not found"
-
-- Make sure you downloaded the `.p8` file from App Store Connect
-- Place it in your project root directory
-- The filename should be `AuthKey_<KEY_ID>.p8`
-
-### "Authentication failed"
-
-- Check that your Issuer ID is correct
-- Verify the API key hasn't expired in App Store Connect
-- Ensure the API key has appropriate permissions
-
-### "No signing certificate found"
-
-- Make sure certificates are uploaded to App Store Connect
-- Check that your Apple Developer account is active
-- Try: `asc signing certs list`
-
-### "Provisioning profile not found"
-
-- With automatic signing, this should auto-resolve
-- Check bundle identifier matches: `com.jling.udoapp`
-
-## Migration Path
-
-You can use both methods:
-
-```bash
-# Manual signing
-asc workflow run release-beta
-
-# Automatic signing (after setup) - choose one:
-pnpm release:beta                                    # npm script
-./scripts/release-beta-auto.sh                       # wrapper script
-source .env.codesign && asc workflow run release-beta-auto --file .asc/workflow-automatic.json  # manual inline
-```
-
-`package.json` already maps `release:beta` to the automatic signing workflow.
-
-## Security Notes
-
-- Never commit `.env.codesign` to git (already in .gitignore)
-- The API key file (`.p8`) is sensitive - keep it secure
-- Consider using a secrets manager for the Issuer ID in CI/CD
-- The `.p8` file is already in `.gitignore` by default
-
-## Next Steps
-
-1. Download your API key from App Store Connect (if you haven't already)
-2. Place the `AuthKey_*.p8` file in your project root
-3. Run: `./scripts/setup-automatic-signing.sh`
-4. Test with: `asc workflow run release-beta-auto --file .asc/workflow-automatic.json --dry-run`
-5. If it looks good, run the real build!

-# U Do iOS Release Automation
-
-This document explains how to build and release the U Do iOS app using command line tools.
-
-## Quick Start
-
-### Option 1: Use `pnpm release:beta` (Recommended)
-
-```bash
-# Automatic signing workflow (build number auto-increments)
-# Requires .env.codesign (see AUTOMATIC_CODE_SIGNING.md)
-pnpm release:beta
-
-# With custom version and/or build number:
-VERSION=1.0.1 BUILD_NUMBER=20 pnpm release:beta
-
-# Dry run (preview without executing)
-pnpm release:beta -- --dry-run
-```
-
-### Option 2: Use asc workflow (manual signing)
-
-```bash
-# One-shot: Build, upload, and distribute (build number auto-increments)
-asc workflow run release-beta
-
-# With custom version and/or build number:
-VERSION=1.0.1 BUILD_NUMBER=20 asc workflow run release-beta
-
-# Dry run (preview without executing)
-asc workflow run release-beta --dry-run
-
-# Or step by step:
-asc workflow run build-only          # Just build and export IPA
-asc workflow run upload-only IPA_PATH:/path/to/app.ipa  # Upload existing IPA
-asc workflow run distribute-latest   # Distribute latest build to beta
-```
-
-### Option 3: Use the shell script (manual signing)
-
-```bash
-# Auto-increment build number
-./scripts/release-beta.sh
-
-# With custom build number
-./scripts/release-beta.sh "" 20
-
-# With custom version and build number
-./scripts/release-beta.sh 1.0.1 20
-```
-
-### Option 4: Use asc publish (Fastest)
-
-If you already have an IPA:
-
-```bash
-asc publish testflight \
-  --app 6760480210 \
-  --ipa /path/to/UDo.ipa \
-  --group 00c630e2-6c85-4636-824c-90c4156aa7f5 \
-  --wait
-```
-
-## Common Xcode Command Line Build Issues
-
-### 1. Code Signing Errors
-
-**Error**: `No signing certificate "iPhone Distribution" found`
-
-**Solution**: Unlock the keychain before building:
-
-```bash
-security unlock-keychain -p "$(cat ~/.password)" ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db
-```
-
-Or set it in the workflow:
-
-```bash
-security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db
-```
-
-### 2. Provisioning Profile Not Found
-
-**Error**: `Provisioning profile not found`
-
-**Solution**: The provisioning profile UUID is already set in the ExportOptions.plist and workflow. Make sure the profile is installed:
-
-```bash
-# List installed profiles
-ls -la ~/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning\ Profiles/ | grep e3545d2d
-```
-
-### 3. Build Hangs or Times Out
-
-**Error**: Build takes forever or times out
-
-**Solutions**:
-
-- Make sure you're not running a build in Xcode simultaneously
-- Clean the build folder: `rm -rf ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData`
-- Check that CocoaPods are up to date: `cd apps/frontend/ios && pod install`
-
-### 4. "No such file or directory" for workspace
-
-**Error**: `Workspace not found`
-
-**Solution**: Make sure you're running from the project root:
-
-```bash
-cd /path/to/u-do-app  # Change to your project root
-```
-
-## Manual Build Process
-
-If you need to debug, here's the step-by-step manual process:
-
-```bash
-# 1. Clean
-cd apps/frontend/ios
-xcodebuild clean -workspace UDo.xcworkspace -scheme "UDo" -configuration Release
-
-# 2. Archive
-xcodebuild archive \
-  -workspace UDo.xcworkspace \
-  -scheme "UDo" \
-  -configuration Release \
-  -archivePath /tmp/UDo.xcarchive \
-  -destination "generic/platform=iOS"
-
-# 3. Export IPA
-xcodebuild -exportArchive \
-  -archivePath /tmp/UDo.xcarchive \
-  -exportPath /tmp/UDo-export \
-  -exportOptionsPlist ExportOptions.plist \
-  -allowProvisioningUpdates
-
-# 4. Upload
-asc builds upload --app 6760480210 --ipa /tmp/UDo-export/UDo.ipa --wait
-
-# 5. Distribute to beta group
-asc builds latest --app 6760480210 --platform IOS --limit 1 | jq -r '.data[0].id' | xargs -I {} asc builds add-groups --build {} --group 00c630e2-6c85-4636-824c-90c4156aa7f5
-```
-
-## Workflows Without Root Scripts
-
-These workflows are still supported, but no longer have root `release:*` scripts:
-
-```bash
-# Automatic signing dry run (former release:beta:auto:dry)
-source .env.codesign && asc workflow run release-beta-auto --file .asc/workflow-automatic.json --dry-run
-
-# Manual signing dry run (former release:beta:dry)
-asc workflow run release-beta --dry-run
-
-# Build only (former release:build)
-asc workflow run build-only
-
-# Distribute latest build (former release:distribute)
-asc workflow run distribute-latest
-```
-
-## Configuration
-
-### Key Values
-
-- **App ID**: `6760480210`
-- **Bundle ID**: `com.jling.udoapp`
-- **Beta Group ID**: `00c630e2-6c85-4636-824c-90c4156aa7f5` ("Beta Testers")
-- **Team ID**: `2M44US8WCT`
-- **Provisioning Profile**: `e3545d2d-b40a-4f40-aa34-f04f186dac97`
-
-### Files
-
-- `apps/frontend/ios/ExportOptions.plist` - Export configuration
-- `.asc/workflow.json` - Manual signing workflows
-- `.asc/workflow-automatic.json` - Automatic signing workflows
-- `scripts/release-beta.sh` - Shell script alternative
-
-## Troubleshooting
-
-### Check your setup:
-
-```bash
-# Verify asc is authenticated
-asc auth status
-
-# Verify app exists
-asc apps list
-
-# List beta groups
-asc testflight beta-groups list --app 6760480210
-
-# List recent builds
-asc builds list --app 6760480210 --limit 5
-```
-
-### Test build without uploading:
-
-```bash
-asc workflow run build-only
-```
-
-### Dry run (preview without executing):
-
-```bash
-pnpm release:beta -- --dry-run
-```
-
-## Code Signing
-
-`pnpm release:beta` uses **automatic code signing** via `.env.codesign` and `.asc/workflow-automatic.json`. For manual signing (hardcoded provisioning profile UUID), run `asc workflow run release-beta`. For setup details, see [AUTOMATIC_CODE_SIGNING.md](./AUTOMATIC_CODE_SIGNING.md).
-
-Quick automatic signing setup:
-
-```bash
-# 1. Get Issuer ID from App Store Connect → Users and Access → Keys
-# 2. Run setup script
-./scripts/setup-automatic-signing.sh
-
-# 3. Use automatic signing
-pnpm release:beta
-```
-
-## Version and Build Number Management
-
-The release workflows now automatically handle build number incrementing:
-
-### Automatic Build Number (Default)
-
-By default, the workflow will:
-
-1. Query App Store Connect for the latest build number
-2. Increment it by 1
-3. Update the Xcode project before building
-
-### Custom Build Number
-
-Override the automatic increment by providing a build number:
-
-```bash
-# Using asc workflow
-BUILD_NUMBER=25 asc workflow run release-beta
-
-# Using pnpm (automatic signing)
-BUILD_NUMBER=25 pnpm release:beta
-
-# Using shell script
-./scripts/release-beta.sh "" 25
-```
-
-### Custom Version
-
-If you need to set a specific version (rarely needed as it's set in the project):
-
-```bash
-VERSION=1.0.1 pnpm release:beta
-```
-
-### Both Version and Build
-
-```bash
-VERSION=1.0.1 BUILD_NUMBER=25 pnpm release:beta
-```
-
-## Tips
-
-1. **Build numbers auto-increment**: Each upload must have a unique build number. The workflow now handles this automatically by querying ASC and incrementing. You only need to manually specify if you want a specific number.
-
-2. **Use `--wait` flag**: The upload command waits for processing to complete before continuing.
-
-3. **Check build status**: If a build fails to process, check:
-
-   ```bash
-   asc builds list --app 6760480210 --limit 1
-   ```
-
-4. **Keep the provisioning profile updated (manual signing only)**: If it expires, download a new one from Apple Developer Portal and update the UUID in:
-   - `ExportOptions.plist`
-   - `.asc/workflow.json`
-   - `scripts/release-beta.sh`
-
-   Or switch to [automatic code signing](./AUTOMATIC_CODE_SIGNING.md) to avoid this.
-
-## Next Steps
-
-1. Try a dry run first:
-
-   ```bash
-   pnpm release:beta -- --dry-run
-   ```
-
-2. If it looks good, run the real thing:
-
-   ```bash
-   pnpm release:beta
-   ```
-
-3. If you need manual signing instead, run:
-
-   ```bash
-   asc workflow run release-beta
-   ```

diff --git a/apps/frontend/ios/Podfile b/apps/frontend/ios/Podfile
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3ebbc37
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/frontend/ios/Podfile
@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+# Set by expo-router. This enables Fabric-only features from react-native-screens
+ENV['RNS_GAMMA_ENABLED'] ||= '1'
+require File.join(File.dirname(`node --print "require.resolve('expo/package.json')"`), "scripts/autolinking")
+require File.join(File.dirname(`node --print "require.resolve('react-native/package.json')"`), "scripts/react_native_pods")
+
+require 'json'
+podfile_properties = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(__dir__, 'Podfile.properties.json'))) rescue {}
+
+def ccache_enabled?(podfile_properties)
+  # Environment variable takes precedence
+  return ENV['USE_CCACHE'] == '1' if ENV['USE_CCACHE']
+
+  # Fall back to Podfile properties
+  podfile_properties['apple.ccacheEnabled'] == 'true'
+end
+
+ENV['EX_DEV_CLIENT_NETWORK_INSPECTOR'] ||= podfile_properties['EX_DEV_CLIENT_NETWORK_INSPECTOR']
+ENV['RCT_USE_RN_DEP'] ||= '1' if podfile_properties['ios.buildReactNativeFromSource'] != 'true'
+ENV['RCT_USE_PREBUILT_RNCORE'] ||= '1' if podfile_properties['ios.buildReactNativeFromSource'] != 'true'
+ENV['RCT_HERMES_V1_ENABLED'] ||= '1' if podfile_properties['expo.useHermesV1'] == 'true'
+platform :ios, podfile_properties['ios.deploymentTarget'] || '15.1'
+
+prepare_react_native_project!
+
+target 'UDo' do
+  use_expo_modules!
+
+  # Periscope network monitor — not on the CocoaPods trunk yet, so declare the source repo explicitly.
+  # No 0.5.5 tag exists upstream; pin to the main-branch commit whose podspec declares 0.5.5
+  # (PeriscopeBridge 0.5.5 depends on PeriscopeKit = 0.5.5).
+  pod 'PeriscopeKit', :git => 'https://github.com/ryanneilstroud/PeriscopeKit.git', :commit => '984be197b42cc51544546bf33884d79336614f74'
+
+  if ENV['EXPO_USE_COMMUNITY_AUTOLINKING'] == '1'
+    config_command = ['node', '-e', "process.argv=['', '', 'config'];require('@react-native-community/cli').run()"];
+  else
+    config_command = [
+      'node',
+      '--no-warnings',
+      '--eval',
+      'require(\'expo/bin/autolinking\')',
+      'expo-modules-autolinking',
+      'react-native-config',
+      '--json',
+      '--platform',
+      'ios'
+    ]
+  end
+
+  config = use_native_modules!(config_command)
+
+  use_frameworks! :linkage => podfile_properties['ios.useFrameworks'].to_sym if podfile_properties['ios.useFrameworks']
+  use_frameworks! :linkage => ENV['USE_FRAMEWORKS'].to_sym if ENV['USE_FRAMEWORKS']
+
+  use_react_native!(
+    :path => config[:reactNativePath],
+    :hermes_enabled => podfile_properties['expo.jsEngine'] == nil || podfile_properties['expo.jsEngine'] == 'hermes',
+    # An absolute path to your application root.
+    :app_path => "#{Pod::Config.instance.installation_root}/..",
+    :privacy_file_aggregation_enabled => podfile_properties['apple.privacyManifestAggregationEnabled'] != 'false',
+  )
+
+  post_install do |installer|
+    react_native_post_install(
+      installer,
+      config[:reactNativePath],
+      :mac_catalyst_enabled => false,
+      :ccache_enabled => ccache_enabled?(podfile_properties),
+    )
+  end
+end

diff --git a/apps/frontend/ios/UDo/AppDelegate.swift b/apps/frontend/ios/UDo/AppDelegate.swift
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9670a1f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/frontend/ios/UDo/AppDelegate.swift
@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@
+internal import Expo
+import React
+import ReactAppDependencyProvider
+
+@main
+class AppDelegate: ExpoAppDelegate {
+  var window: UIWindow?
+
+  var reactNativeDelegate: ExpoReactNativeFactoryDelegate?
+  var reactNativeFactory: RCTReactNativeFactory?
+
+  public override func application(
+    _ application: UIApplication,
+    didFinishLaunchingWithOptions launchOptions: [UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: Any]? = nil
+  ) -> Bool {
+    let delegate = ReactNativeDelegate()
+    let factory = ExpoReactNativeFactory(delegate: delegate)
+    delegate.dependencyProvider = RCTAppDependencyProvider()
+
+    reactNativeDelegate = delegate
+    reactNativeFactory = factory
+
+#if os(iOS) || os(tvOS)
+    window = UIWindow(frame: UIScreen.main.bounds)
+    factory.startReactNative(
+      withModuleName: "main",
+      in: window,
+      launchOptions: launchOptions)
+#endif
+
+    return super.application(application, didFinishLaunchingWithOptions: launchOptions)
+  }
+
+  // Linking API
+  public override func application(
+    _ app: UIApplication,
+    open url: URL,
+    options: [UIApplication.OpenURLOptionsKey: Any] = [:]
+  ) -> Bool {
+    return super.application(app, open: url, options: options) || RCTLinkingManager.application(app, open: url, options: options)
+  }
+
+  // Universal Links
+  public override func application(
+    _ application: UIApplication,
+    continue userActivity: NSUserActivity,
+    restorationHandler: @escaping ([UIUserActivityRestoring]?) -> Void
+  ) -> Bool {
+    let result = RCTLinkingManager.application(application, continue: userActivity, restorationHandler: restorationHandler)
+    return super.application(application, continue: userActivity, restorationHandler: restorationHandler) || result
+  }
+}
+
+class ReactNativeDelegate: ExpoReactNativeFactoryDelegate {
+  // Extension point for config-plugins
+
+  override func sourceURL(for bridge: RCTBridge) -> URL? {
+    // needed to return the correct URL for expo-dev-client.
+    bridge.bundleURL ?? bundleURL()
+  }
+
+  override func bundleURL() -> URL? {
+#if DEBUG
+    return RCTBundleURLProvider.sharedSettings().jsBundleURL(forBundleRoot: ".expo/.virtual-metro-entry")
+#else
+    return Bundle.main.url(forResource: "main", withExtension: "jsbundle")
+#endif
+  }
+}

+# Prepare the checked-in Expo iOS project for Xcode Cloud.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+ios_dir="$(cd "${script_dir}/.." && pwd)"
+repo_root="$(cd "${ios_dir}/../../.." && pwd)"
+expected_node="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "${repo_root}/.node-version")"
+
+use_node_24() {
+  if ! command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "Xcode Cloud needs Homebrew to install Node 24, but brew is unavailable." >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+
+  brew install node@24
+  for node_dir in /opt/homebrew/opt/node@24/bin /usr/local/opt/node@24/bin; do
+    if [ -x "${node_dir}/node" ]; then
+      export PATH="${node_dir}:${PATH}"
+      return
+    fi
+  done
+
+  echo "Node 24 installed, but its binary was not found." >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+
+current_node=""
+if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+  current_node="$(node -p 'process.versions.node')"
+fi
+if [ -z "${current_node}" ] || [ "${current_node%%.*}" != "${expected_node%%.*}" ]; then
+  use_node_24
+fi
+
+current_node="$(node -p 'process.versions.node')"
+if [ "${current_node%%.*}" != "${expected_node%%.*}" ]; then
+  printf 'Node %s is required; Node %s is still active after setup.\n' \
+    "${expected_node}" "${current_node}" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+if ! command -v corepack >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+  npm install --global corepack@latest
+fi
+corepack enable
+cd "${repo_root}"
+corepack prepare "$(node -p "require('./package.json').packageManager")" --activate
+pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+
+export NODE_BINARY="$(command -v node)"
+cd "${ios_dir}"
+pod install --deployment
+
+# The Default workflow archives a tagged main commit as an App Store candidate.
+# Alpha workflows keep the checked-in native marketing version unchanged.
+if [ "${CI_WORKFLOW:-}" = "Default" ]; then
+  if [ -z "${CI_TAG:-}" ]; then
+    echo "The Default candidate workflow must run from an exact main tag." >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+  node "${repo_root}/scripts/sync-ios-version.mjs"
+fi

summary.why: It prepares the checked-in workspace consistently before Xcode Cloud builds.
details: Installs Node through Homebrew when needed.
Uses frozen pnpm and deployment-mode CocoaPods installs.

--- a/docs/DEPLOYMENT_FLOW.md

@@ -1,406 +1,110 @@
-# Git-Based Deployment & Release Flow
+# Deployment and release flow
 
-This document describes the automated deployment and release workflow for the U-Do app using Conventional Commits and semantic-release.
+`next` is the integration branch. `main` is the production baseline. Semantic
+release still makes GitHub releases; it does not make iOS builds.
 
-## Overview
+## Alpha TestFlight builds
 
-**What happens automatically:**
-- Push to `next` → Release-candidate tag created (`v1.5.0-next.1`)
-- Push to `main` → Production release created on GitHub with auto-generated notes
-- Vercel deployments happen automatically via git integration (no GitHub Actions needed)
+GitHub Actions checks each eligible push to `next`, then creates an immutable
+`alpha/<commit-sha>` tag. That tag starts the Xcode Cloud Alpha workflow.
 
-**What you do manually:**
-- Internal TestFlight builds using `pnpm release:alpha`
-- External TestFlight promotion using `pnpm release:beta`
-- App Store submission of an approved beta build using `pnpm release:store`
+The workflow:
 
-## Branch Strategy
+1. Builds the checked-in `apps/frontend/ios` workspace with automatic signing.
+2. Uploads a **TestFlight Internal Only** build to the existing Alpha group.
+3. Starts at build number 55. Xcode Cloud owns later build numbers.
+4. Uses the marketing version in `apps/frontend/app.json`.
+5. Sets TestFlight notes from the commit title, SHA, and Xcode Cloud link.
 
-```
-feature/*  →  next  →  main
-     ↓           ↓        ↓
-   (PR)    (dev tag)  (release)
-```
-
-### Branches
-
-- **`next`** (default branch): Integration branch for development
-- **`main`**: Production branch - releases happen here
-- **`feature/*`**: Feature branches for development
-
-## How It Works
-
-### 1. Conventional Commits
-
-All commits must follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format:
-
-```
-<type>(<scope>): <subject>
-```
-
-**Use `git cz` instead of `git commit`** for interactive prompts.
-
-**Types:**
-- `feat`: New feature → **minor** version bump (1.0.0 → 1.1.0)
-- `fix`: Bug fix → **patch** version bump (1.0.0 → 1.1.1)
-- `BREAKING CHANGE`: Breaking change → **major** version bump (1.0.0 → 2.0.0)
-- `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `chore`: No version bump
+GitHub does not poll Xcode Cloud. Apple sends the build result notification.
+If a build fails, rerun it from Xcode Cloud. The release flow does not retry it.
+Old tags and TestFlight builds stay in place.
 
-**Scopes:** `ios`, `android`, `web`, `backend`, `auth`, `ui`
+The first run is manual. Keep the GitHub repository variable
+`ALPHA_AUTOMATION_ENABLED` unset or false until it works. Then set it to true
+to enable push-triggered alpha builds. Use `pnpm release:alpha` to dispatch a
+manual alpha run. It accepts only a commit reachable from `next`. Add
+`[skip alpha]` to a commit title to skip it.
 
-### 2. semantic-release
+GitHub may stop stale work before it creates a tag. It never stops a production
+backend deploy or an Xcode Cloud build that has already started.
 
-semantic-release analyzes commits and:
-- Determines the next version number
-- Updates `package.json` (root and frontend)
-- Creates git tags
-- Creates GitHub Releases (production only)
-- Generates release notes from commits
+## Backend rule for alpha
 
-### 3. Vercel Deployments
+The alpha job runs `pnpm verify:ci` first. It then compares the backend with
+`main`.
 
-Vercel automatically deploys via git:
-- Push to `next` → Preview deployment
-- Push to `main` → Production deployment
+- It deploys only changes under `packages/backend/convex/experimental/`.
+- Any other backend difference blocks the alpha run until `main` contains it.
+- Experimental APIs must use the server-side tester guard. They may change
+  while tester access stays limited. Stable APIs still follow the production
+  compatibility contract.
 
-No configuration or secrets needed in GitHub!
+GitHub holds only the production Convex deploy key. It does not hold Apple
+signing data.
 
-#### Docs-only builds are skipped
+## Xcode Cloud setup
 
-Both Vercel projects (`apps/frontend` and `apps/landing`) set an Ignored Build
-Step via [`ignoreCommand`](https://vercel.com/docs/project-configuration/vercel-json#ignorecommand)
-in their `vercel.json`, pointing at
-[`scripts/vercel-skip-docs-only.sh`](../scripts/vercel-skip-docs-only.sh). When a
-push changes documentation only, the build is cancelled on every branch (preview
-*and* production) — there's nothing to rebuild or redeploy.
+Commit the iOS workspace, project, shared scheme, app sources, `Podfile`, and
+`Podfile.lock`. Do not commit Pods, build output, user data, `.xcode.env`, or
+`sentry.properties`.
 
-A change counts as docs-only when **every** file changed since the last
-successful deploy (`VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA`) is a `.md`/`.mdx` file, lives under
-a `docs/`, `plans/`, or `task-packets/` directory, or is `LICENSE`. Any other
-path — or any case the script can't classify with confidence (first deploy,
-shallow clone missing the previous SHA) — falls through to a full build.
-
-The bias toward building is deliberate: the frontend's production build runs
-`npx convex deploy` (see `apps/frontend/scripts/webdeploy.sh`), so the Vercel
-build is also how the backend ships. Over-skipping could strand a backend
-deploy, so the script only skips the unambiguously safe case. Docs are never
-imported into the app bundle and are never shipped by `convex deploy`.
-
-## Development Flow
-
-### 1. Create Feature Branch
+Xcode Cloud runs `apps/frontend/ios/ci_scripts/ci_post_clone.sh`. The script
+installs root dependencies and Pods. It runs the marketing-version sync only
+for the `Default` candidate workflow. Run this check before a native release:
 
 ```bash
-git checkout next
-git pull origin next
-git checkout -b feature/my-feature
+node apps/frontend/scripts/check-ios-config-drift.mjs
 ```
 
-### 2. Make Commits
+Set these production values in Xcode Cloud, not in a checked-in `.env` file:
 
-```bash
-# Make your changes
-git add .
+- `EXPO_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL`
+- `EXPO_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_API_KEY`
+- `EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN`
+- Sentry upload settings needed by the native build
 
-# Use commitizen for interactive commit
-git cz
-# ? Select type: feat
-# ? Select scope: auth
-# ? Subject: add email OTP login
-# Result: feat(auth): add email OTP login
-```
-
-**Husky validates commit messages** - non-conventional commits will be rejected.
+Set up automatic signing, then configure two Xcode Cloud workflows:
 
-### 3. Push and Create PR to `next`
-
-```bash
-git push origin feature/my-feature
-gh pr create --base next --title "feat(auth): add email OTP login"
-```
+- `Alpha`: tag changes matching `alpha/*`, a Release archive, and a TestFlight
+  post-action for the existing Alpha group with **Internal Only** selected.
+- `Default`: manual tag starts only, a Release archive for **TestFlight and App
+  Store**, and a TestFlight post-action for the existing Alpha group.
 
-### 4. Merge to `next`
+Set Xcode Cloud's next build number to 55 before the first archive. The
+`Default` workflow syncs its marketing version from the tagged root
+`package.json`.
 
-After review, merge the PR. This automatically:
-- Creates a release-candidate tag: `v1.5.0-next.1` (incrementing `-next.N` per push)
-- Creates a GitHub Release marked **Pre-release**
-- Vercel deploys to preview URL
+Add the `CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY` repository secret in GitHub. Set
+`EXPERIMENTAL_TESTER_EMAILS` in the production Convex deployment when an
+experiment needs access. Keep `ALPHA_AUTOMATION_ENABLED` false for the first
+manual `pnpm release:alpha` run.
 
-### 5. Promote to Production
+## App Store submission
 
-When ready, create a PR from `next` to `main`:
+Candidates do not promote from an alpha build. Submit an exact, App
+Store-eligible build:
 
 ```bash
-gh pr create --base main --head next --title "Release: v1.x.x"
+VERSION=1.5.4 BUILD_NUMBER=55 pnpm release:store
+VERSION=1.5.4 BUILD_NUMBER=55 CONFIRM=1 pnpm release:store
 ```
 
-Merging to `main` automatically:
-- Determines version from commits (patch/minor/major)
-- Updates `package.json` files
-- Creates release tag: `v1.1.0`
-- Creates GitHub Release with auto-generated notes
-- Vercel deploys to production
-
-## Versioning Examples
-
-### Scenario 1: Bug Fix Release
-
-Commits:
-- `fix(auth): resolve login redirect`
-- `fix(ui): correct button alignment`
-
-Result: **v1.0.1** (patch bump)
-
-### Scenario 2: Feature Release
-
-Commits:
-- `feat(tasks): add recurring tasks`
-- `fix(auth): resolve login redirect`
-
-Result: **v1.1.0** (minor bump from `feat`)
-
-### Scenario 3: Breaking Change
-
-Commits:
-```
-feat(backend): migrate to new API
-
-BREAKING CHANGE: Old endpoints removed
-```
-
-Result: **v2.0.0** (major bump)
-
-## iOS Deployment
-
-iOS builds and TestFlight distribution are done **locally** via the `asc` CLI workflow at `.asc/workflow-automatic.json`, not in CI.
-
-The pipeline has three stages:
-
-| Stage | Command | What it does |
-|---|---|---|
-| **Alpha** | `pnpm release:alpha` | Builds the IPA, uploads to App Store Connect, distributes to the internal "Beta Testers" group (no Apple beta review required) |
-| **Beta** | `pnpm release:beta` | Promotes an existing alpha build to the external "Fam & close friends" group and submits for Apple's beta app review |
-| **Store** | `pnpm release:store` | Promotes an existing TestFlight build to the App Store version and submits it for App Review |
-
-### Alpha (internal TestFlight)
-
-From the repo root:
-
-```bash
-pnpm release:alpha
-```
-
-This runs the `release-alpha-auto` workflow, which:
-
-1. Fetches the next build number from App Store Connect
-2. Bumps `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION` in `apps/frontend/ios/UDo.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`
-3. `xcodebuild archive` → `xcodebuild -exportArchive` using `ExportOptions-Automatic.plist` (`method=app-store-connect`)
-4. `asc builds upload --wait`
-5. `asc builds add-groups` → distributes to the internal alpha group (`ALPHA_GROUP_ID`)
-
-The IPA itself is production-grade — the same artifact promotes through beta and on to the App Store. Only step 5 is alpha-specific.
-
-Before promoting an Alpha build to external Beta or Store, run the
-[Pre-Release Agent Runbook](./testing/pre-release-agent-runbook.md). The runbook
-is report-only: it validates a Release-mode iOS simulator build with the iOS
-Simulator MCP, performs a lightweight release metadata preflight, and records a
-human TestFlight sanity checklist for the uploaded build.
-
-### Beta (external TestFlight)
-
-After an alpha build has been internally tested and you're ready to invite external testers:
-
-```bash
-# Dry-run (default): validates and stages the promotion without submitting
-pnpm release:beta
-
-# Actually submit for Apple beta review
-CONFIRM=1 pnpm release:beta
-```
-
-This runs the `release-beta-promote` workflow, which:
-
-1. Resolves the build (`BUILD_NUMBER` env override, else latest)
-2. Upserts "What to Test" notes for the build if `WHAT_TO_TEST` is provided
-3. `asc validate testflight` — fails loudly if anything blocks external review (missing test notes, beta app description, etc.)
-4. `asc builds add-groups` → adds the build to the external group (`EXTERNAL_GROUP_ID`)
-5. Submits for Apple beta app review **only when `CONFIRM=1`** — otherwise prints a dry-run line
-
-External review can take a day or two and is one-way (you have to cancel the submission to undo), which is why the submit step is gated behind `CONFIRM=1`.
-
-> **Note:** Only the final review submission (step 5) is gated. A default (no-`CONFIRM`) run is *not* a pure dry-run — it still updates the build's "What to Test" notes and adds it to the external group (steps 2 & 4). Those are safe to repeat and external testers can't install until beta review passes, but the run is not side-effect-free.
-
-Env knobs:
-
-```bash
-BUILD_NUMBER=28 WHAT_TO_TEST="Try the new sign-in flow." CONFIRM=1 pnpm release:beta
-```
-
-### Store (App Store)
-
-After an external beta build has been approved by Apple and you're ready to ship:
-
-```bash
-# Dry-run (default): validates the version + build, stops before submission
-VERSION=1.0 pnpm release:store
-
-# Actually submit for App Review
-VERSION=1.0 CONFIRM=1 pnpm release:store
-```
-
-This runs the `release-store-promote` workflow, which:
-
-1. Requires an explicit `VERSION` (must match what already exists in App Store Connect — create it via the ASC UI or `asc versions create` first)
-2. Resolves the build (`BUILD_NUMBER` env override, else latest)
-3. Verifies the App Store version exists
-4. `asc validate` — runs the App Store readiness checks (metadata, screenshots, age rating, pricing, etc.)
-5. `asc submit create` — attaches the build to the version and submits for review **only when `CONFIRM=1`** — otherwise prints a dry-run line
-
-Env knobs:
-
-```bash
-VERSION=1.0 BUILD_NUMBER=28 CONFIRM=1 pnpm release:store
-```
-
-App Store submission is one-way (you have to cancel the submission to undo), which is why the submit step is gated behind `CONFIRM=1`.
-
-### Re-prebuilding / re-syncing the iOS workspace before an alpha release
-
-`pnpm release:alpha` runs `xcodebuild` against the **already-prebuilt** iOS workspace under `apps/frontend/ios/`. It does **not** invoke `expo prebuild`, so two kinds of out-of-band changes can leave the workspace stale relative to the repo:
-
-1. **`app.json` / native-config edits** (icons, splash, plugins, `infoPlist`, `bundleIdentifier`, `supportsTablet`, etc.) won't propagate into the generated Xcode project on their own.
-2. **Dependency upgrades / `pnpm-lock.yaml` changes** — especially anything that adds, removes, or re-resolves a native module — won't be reflected in the CocoaPods workspace (`Pods/`, `Podfile.lock`) on their own. This is what caused the `release:alpha` failure where `@expo/vector-icons` 15.x dropped its transitive `react-native-vector-icons`: the prebuilt Pods still referenced `RNVectorIconsManager.mm`, and the archive died with exit 65 (`Build input file cannot be found`).
-
-**For `app.json` / native-config changes, re-run prebuild before the release:**
-
-```bash
-pnpm --filter @apps/frontend exec expo prebuild --platform ios --clean
-```
-
-This regenerates the Xcode project (and runs `pod install`). Skipping it is a common source of "I changed app.json but the build still has the old behavior" bugs.
-
-**For dependency / `pnpm-lock.yaml` changes, a Pods-only sync is enough** — and is now done automatically. The `release-alpha-auto` workflow runs a **Syncing CocoaPods** step (a `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` reconcile of `node_modules` followed by `pod install` in `apps/frontend/ios`) before it cleans and archives, so the workspace self-heals to match the current lockfile on every alpha build. Prefer `pod install` over `expo prebuild --clean` here: it only updates the Pods and leaves the in-place build-number, marketing-version, and signing edits the workflow makes untouched.
-
-If you ever need to do this by hand (e.g. building the IPA outside the workflow, or recovering from a stale workspace), the fast manual recovery is:
-
-```bash
-cd apps/frontend/ios && NODE_BINARY=$(command -v node) pod install
-```
-
-Because the workflow now self-heals Pods, that manual `pod install` is a fallback rather than a required pre-release step. Re-prebuilding (`expo prebuild`) is still required for `app.json` / native-config changes — the auto-sync only reconciles Pods, not the generated Xcode project.
-
-`pnpm release:beta` doesn't build, so it's unaffected by either case.
-
-### Frontend env vars (`EXPO_PUBLIC_*`)
-
-`EXPO_PUBLIC_*` vars are baked into the JS bundle **at build time** by Metro. For `release:alpha` they come from `apps/frontend/.env.production` (gitignored) or the shell environment.
-
-When introducing a new `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` var:
-
-1. Add it to `apps/frontend/.env.example` so the contract is documented
-2. Add the real value to your local `apps/frontend/.env.production`
-
-A missing var here will silently bundle as `undefined`, so the only sign that something is wrong will show up at runtime in the app.
-
-## Setup
-
-### 1. Run Setup Script
-
-```bash
-./scripts/setup-deployment-flow.sh
-```
-
-This will:
-- Install dependencies (commitizen, semantic-release, husky, commitlint)
-- Create `next` branch
-- Set `next` as default branch on GitHub
-- Configure branch protection for `main`
-
-### 2. No Secrets Required!
-
-**Vercel** handles deployments automatically via git - no secrets needed.
-
-**GitHub Actions** use the built-in `GITHUB_TOKEN` - no additional secrets.
-
-### 3. Branch Protection
-
-The setup script configures branch protection for `main`:
-- Requires `lint` workflow to pass
-- Requires `test` workflow to pass
-
-## Files Created
-
-### Configuration
-- `.czrc` - Commitizen configuration with scopes
-- `commitlint.config.js` - Commit message validation rules
-- `.releaserc` - semantic-release configuration
-- `.husky/commit-msg` - Git hook for commit validation
-
-### GitHub Actions
-- `.github/workflows/release-dev.yml` - Creates release-candidate tags on push to `next`
-- `.github/workflows/release-prod.yml` - Creates production releases on push to `main`
-
-### Documentation
-- `CONTRIBUTING.md` - Updated with commit guidelines and workflow
-- `docs/DEPLOYMENT_FLOW.md` - This file
-
-## Monitoring
-
-### Tags
-- View all tags: https://github.com/itsjling/u-do-app/tags
-- Release-candidate tags: `v*.*.*-next.*`
-- Production tags: `v*.*.*`
-
-### Releases
-- View releases: https://github.com/itsjling/u-do-app/releases
-- Production releases are marked as the latest release
-- Release-candidate tags get a GitHub Release page marked **Pre-release**
-
-### Vercel
-- View deployments: https://vercel.com/itsjling/u-do-2/deployments
-- Preview deployments from `next` branch
-- Production deployments from `main` branch
-
-### Workflow Runs
-- View actions: https://github.com/itsjling/u-do-app/actions
-- Release workflows run automatically on branch pushes
-
-## Troubleshooting
-
-### Commit Rejected by Husky
-
-If your commit is rejected:
-
-1. Check the error message - it will tell you what's wrong
-2. Common issues:
-   - Missing scope (must be one of: ios, android, web, backend, auth, ui)
-   - Missing type (must be: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, chore)
-   - Subject too long (max 72 characters)
-
-### semantic-release Not Creating Release
-
-1. Check workflow logs in GitHub Actions
-2. Ensure commits follow conventional format
-3. For production: Must have at least one `feat`, `fix`, or `BREAKING CHANGE` commit since last release
-
-### Version Not Bumping
+Both `VERSION` and `BUILD_NUMBER` are required. The first command validates and
+shows the intended submission. The second sends it. The local workflow rejects
+missing or internal-only build audiences before it can submit anything.
 
-- Only `feat`, `fix`, `perf`, and `BREAKING CHANGE` trigger version bumps
-- `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `test`, `chore` do not trigger releases
+There is no external TestFlight beta promotion flow.
 
-## Migration from Current Setup
+## Cost and limits
 
-1. ✅ Review configuration files
-2. ✅ Review this documentation
-3. ⬜ Run setup script
-4. ⬜ Test with a `fix:` or `feat:` commit to `next`
-5. ⬜ Verify dev tag is created
-6. ⬜ Create PR from `next` to `main`
-7. ⬜ Merge to `main` and verify production release
+The expected alpha flow uses about 720–800 of the 2,000 GitHub Actions minutes
+included in the free plan and about 6.6 of the 25 Xcode Cloud hours each month.
+Those estimates assume no polling and modest push volume. Check the GitHub and
+Apple usage pages after the first month.
 
-## Resources
+## Web deployment
 
-- [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
-- [semantic-release](https://semantic-release.gitbook.io/)
-- [Commitizen](http://commitizen.github.io/cz-cli/)
-- [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
+Vercel still deploys from Git: `next` makes a preview and `main` makes the web
+production deployment. Its backend deployment path remains separate from the
+alpha TestFlight flow.

diff --git a/scripts/dispatch-release-handoff.sh b/scripts/dispatch-release-handoff.sh
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..5c2ea30
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/dispatch-release-handoff.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+#
+# Dispatch the immutable next commit that GitHub checks before it deploys and
+# creates an alpha tag for Xcode Cloud.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+usage() {
+  printf 'Usage: %s alpha\n' "${0##*/}" >&2
+}
+
+if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
+  usage
+  exit 64
+fi
+
+if [ "$1" != "alpha" ]; then
+  usage
+  exit 64
+fi
+
+branch="next"
+
+repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || {
+  printf 'Run this command from a Git repository.\n' >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+cd "$repo_root"
+
+GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git fetch --quiet origin \
+  "+refs/heads/${branch}:refs/remotes/origin/${branch}"
+

summary.what: Adds the handoff validator for commit reachability, skip markers, stale pushes, release-only branch advances, and backend path safety.
summary.why: It protects the GitHub workflow from handing off stale commits or deploying stable backend changes that are absent from `main`.
details: Allows experimental backend files and selected generated bindings.
Rejects generated bindings without experimental source changes.
Treats semantic-release-only advances as ready.

new file mode 100755
index 0000000..4db9de1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/run-xcode-candidate.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,85 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+#
+# Start Xcode Cloud's Default workflow for one existing stable production tag.
+# The tag is resolved through App Store Connect so this command never falls
+# back to a branch tip.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+app_id="${ASC_APP_ID:-6760480210}"
+tag="${TAG:-}"
+
+if ! [[ "$tag" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+  printf 'Set TAG to an existing stable production tag such as v1.7.0.\n' >&2
+  exit 64
+fi
+
+repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || {
+  printf 'Run this command from a Git repository.\n' >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+cd "$repo_root"
+
+GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git fetch --quiet origin \
+  "+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main" \
+  "+refs/tags/${tag}:refs/tags/${tag}"
+
+commit_sha="$(git rev-parse "${tag}^{commit}")" || {
+  printf 'Production tag %s does not resolve to a commit.\n' "$tag" >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$commit_sha" origin/main; then
+  printf 'Production tag %s (%s) is not reachable from origin/main.\n' \
+    "$tag" "$commit_sha" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+if [ "${UDO_RELEASE_DRY_RUN:-}" = "1" ]; then
+  printf 'Would run Xcode Cloud Default for %s (%s).\n' "$tag" "$commit_sha"
+  exit 0
+fi
+
+command -v asc >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
+  printf 'asc is required to start the Xcode Cloud candidate build.\n' >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+
+if ! workflows="$(asc xcode-cloud workflows list --app "$app_id" --paginate)"; then
+  printf 'Xcode Cloud setup error: could not list workflows for app %s.\n' "$app_id" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+workflow_id="$(jq -er '
+  [.data[]? | select(.attributes.name == "Default") | .id]
+  | if length == 1 then .[0] else error("expected exactly one Default workflow") end
+' <<<"$workflows")" || {
+  printf 'Xcode Cloud setup error: could not resolve exactly one Default workflow.\n' >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+
+if ! repository="$(asc xcode-cloud workflows repository --id "$workflow_id")"; then
+  printf 'Xcode Cloud setup error: could not resolve the Default source repository.\n' >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+repository_id="$(jq -er '.data.id' <<<"$repository")" || {
+  printf 'Xcode Cloud setup error: Default has no source repository.\n' >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+
+if ! references="$(asc xcode-cloud scm repositories git-references \
+  --repo-id "$repository_id" --paginate)"; then
+  printf 'Xcode Cloud setup error: could not list the repository git references.\n' >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+reference_id="$(jq -er --arg canonical_name "refs/tags/${tag}" '
+  [.data[]? | select(.attributes.canonicalName == $canonical_name) | .id]
+  | if length == 1 then .[0] else error("tag reference not found") end
+' <<<"$references")" || {
+  printf 'Xcode Cloud setup error: no git reference for refs/tags/%s.\n' "$tag" >&2
+  printf 'Push the tag and wait for Xcode Cloud to sync it, then try again.\n' >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+
+if ! asc xcode-cloud run --workflow-id "$workflow_id" --git-reference-id "$reference_id"; then
+  printf 'Xcode Cloud handoff failed for refs/tags/%s.\n' "$tag" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+printf 'Started Xcode Cloud Default for %s (%s).\n' "$tag" "$commit_sha"

summary.why: It prevents candidate builds from falling back to a branch tip or ambiguous cloud workflow.

+++ b/scripts/test/dispatch-release-handoff.bats
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+
+bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
+
+setup() {
+  DISPATCH="${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../dispatch-release-handoff.sh"
+  REPO="$(mktemp -d)"
+  cd "$REPO"
+  git init -q -b next
+  git config user.email "test@example.com"
+  git config user.name "Test"
+  git config commit.gpgsign false
+  printf 'base\n' >README.md
+  git add README.md
+  git commit -qm base
+  SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
+  git update-ref refs/remotes/origin/next "$SHA"
+  git update-ref refs/remotes/origin/main "$SHA"
+
+  mkdir remote.git
+  git init -q --bare remote.git
+  git remote add origin "$REPO/remote.git"
+  git push -q origin "refs/remotes/origin/next:refs/heads/next"
+  git push -q origin "refs/remotes/origin/main:refs/heads/main"
+}
+
+teardown() {
+  cd /
+  rm -rf "$REPO"
+}
+
+@test "dispatch: alpha dry run selects the current immutable next SHA" {
+  run env UDO_RELEASE_DRY_RUN=1 "$DISPATCH" alpha
+
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"alpha (${SHA}) on next"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "dispatch: rejects a non-alpha handoff" {
+  run env UDO_RELEASE_DRY_RUN=1 "$DISPATCH" candidate
+
+  [ "$status" -eq 64 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"Usage:"* ]]
+}

summary.title: Test alpha dispatch selection
summary.what: Adds tests for selecting the current immutable `next` SHA in dry-run mode and rejecting non-alpha dispatches.
summary.why: It verifies the public behavior of the new alpha dispatch script.

files.patch:
diff --git a/scripts/test/release-handoff.bats b/scripts/test/release-handoff.bats
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5961db8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/test/release-handoff.bats
@@ -0,0 +1,196 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+
+bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
+
+setup() {
+  HELPER="${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../release-handoff.mjs"
+  WORKFLOW="${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../../.github/workflows/release-alpha.yml"
+  REPO="$(mktemp -d)"
+  cd "$REPO"
+  git init -q -b next
+  git config user.email "test@example.com"
+  git config user.name "Test"
+  git config commit.gpgsign false
+
+  mkdir -p packages/backend/convex/experimental
+  printf 'base\n' >README.md
+  git add -A
+  git commit -qm "base"
+  MAIN_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
+  git update-ref refs/remotes/origin/main "$MAIN_SHA"
+  git update-ref refs/remotes/origin/next "$MAIN_SHA"
+}
+
+teardown() {
+  cd /
+  rm -rf "$REPO"
+}
+
+commit_and_track_next() {
+  git add -A
+  git commit -qm "$1"
+  SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
+  git update-ref refs/remotes/origin/next "$SHA"
+}
+
+validate() {
+  node "$HELPER" validate --sha "$SHA" --branch origin/next --event "$1" --base origin/main "${@:2}"
+}
+
+@test "validate: accepts a reachable next commit with no backend change" {
+  printf 'app\n' >app.txt
+  commit_and_track_next "feat: app change"
+
+  run validate workflow_dispatch --dry-run
+
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  run jq -e --arg sha "$SHA" \
+    '.selectedSha == $sha and .status == "ready" and .dryRun == true' <<<"$output"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "validate: rejects a commit that is not reachable from next" {
+  git checkout -qb detached "$MAIN_SHA"
+  printf 'other\n' >other.txt
+  git add -A
+  git commit -qm "feat: detached"
+  SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
+  git checkout -q next
+
+  run validate workflow_dispatch
+
+  [ "$status" -ne 0 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"is not reachable from origin/next"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "validate: skips a commit with [skip alpha]" {
+  printf 'app\n' >app.txt
+  commit_and_track_next "chore: do not build [skip alpha]"
+
+  run validate workflow_dispatch
+
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  run jq -e '.status == "skipped"' <<<"$output"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "validate: accepts experimental-only backend changes" {
+  printf 'export {}\n' >packages/backend/convex/experimental/example.ts
+  commit_and_track_next "feat: experimental endpoint"
+
+  run validate workflow_dispatch
+
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  run jq -e \
+    '.status == "ready" and .experimentalPaths == ["packages/backend/convex/experimental/example.ts"]' \
+    <<<"$output"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "validate: accepts generated bindings with experimental source changes" {
+  mkdir -p packages/backend/convex/_generated
+  printf 'export {}\n' >packages/backend/convex/experimental/example.ts
+  printf 'generated\n' >packages/backend/convex/_generated/api.d.ts
+  commit_and_track_next "feat: experimental endpoint with bindings"
+
+  run validate workflow_dispatch
+
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  run jq -e \
+    '.status == "ready"
+      and .experimentalPaths == ["packages/backend/convex/experimental/example.ts"]
+      and .generatedBindingPaths == ["packages/backend/convex/_generated/api.d.ts"]' \
+    <<<"$output"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "validate: blocks generated bindings without experimental source changes" {
+  mkdir -p packages/backend/convex/_generated
+  printf 'generated\n' >packages/backend/convex/_generated/api.d.ts
+  commit_and_track_next "chore: generated bindings only"
+
+  run validate workflow_dispatch
+
+  [ "$status" -ne 0 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"Stable backend paths differ from origin/main"* ]]
+  [[ "$output" == *"packages/backend/convex/_generated/api.d.ts"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "validate: blocks stable backend changes" {
+  mkdir -p packages/backend/convex
+  printf 'export {}\n' >packages/backend/convex/tasks.ts
+  commit_and_track_next "feat: stable backend endpoint"
+
+  run validate workflow_dispatch
+
+  [ "$status" -ne 0 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"Stable backend paths differ from origin/main"* ]]
+  [[ "$output" == *"packages/backend/convex/tasks.ts"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "validate: blocks a stale push after the branch advances" {
+  printf 'first\n' >first.txt
+  commit_and_track_next "feat: first"
+  stale_sha="$SHA"
+  printf 'second\n' >second.txt
+  commit_and_track_next "feat: second"
+  SHA="$stale_sha"
+
+  run validate push
+
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  run jq -e --arg sha "$SHA" \
+    '.status == "stale" and .selectedSha == $sha' <<<"$output"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "validate: accepts the selected push after semantic-release advances next" {
+  mkdir -p apps/frontend
+  printf '{"version":"1.0.0"}\n' >package.json
+  printf '{"version":"1.0.0"}\n' >apps/frontend/package.json
+  commit_and_track_next "feat: app change"
+  selected_sha="$SHA"
+
+  printf '{"version":"1.0.1-next.1"}\n' >package.json
+  printf '{"version":"1.0.1-next.1"}\n' >apps/frontend/package.json
+  commit_and_track_next "chore(release): 1.0.1-next.1 [skip ci]"
+  SHA="$selected_sha"
+
+  run validate push
+
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  run jq -e --arg sha "$SHA" \
+    '.status == "ready" and .selectedSha == $sha' <<<"$output"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "validate: dry run never mutates refs or the worktree" {
+  printf 'app\n' >app.txt
+  commit_and_track_next "feat: app change"
+  before_head="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
+  before_refs="$(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)')"
+  before_status="$(git status --porcelain)"
+
+  run validate workflow_dispatch --dry-run
+
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$before_head" ]
+  [ "$(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)')" = "$before_refs" ]
+  [ "$(git status --porcelain)" = "$before_status" ]
+}
+
+@test "workflow: alpha automation stays gated and never polls Xcode Cloud" {
+  grep -q "vars.ALPHA_AUTOMATION_ENABLED == 'true'" "$WORKFLOW"
+  grep -q 'cancel-in-progress: false' "$WORKFLOW"

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+
+bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
+
+setup() {
+  WORKFLOW="${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../../.asc/workflow-automatic.json"
+}
+
+@test "store workflow is the only local release workflow" {
+  run jq -e '
+    (.workflows | keys) == ["release-store-promote"]
+    and (.env | has("ALPHA_GROUP_ID") | not)
+    and (.env | has("EXTERNAL_GROUP_ID") | not)
+  ' "$WORKFLOW"
+
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "store workflow requires an exact version and build without latest fallback" {
+  run jq -er '
+    .workflows["release-store-promote"].steps
+    | map(.run)
+    | join("\n")
+    | contains("VERSION and BUILD_NUMBER are required")
+      and contains("--version \"$VERSION\" --build-number \"$BUILD_NUMBER\"")
+      and (contains("builds latest") | not)
+  ' "$WORKFLOW"
+
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "store workflow fails closed unless the build is App Store eligible" {
+  run jq -er '
+    .workflows["release-store-promote"].steps
+    | map(.name) as $names
+    | ($names | index("require_app_store_eligible_build"))
+        < ($names | index("submit_for_review"))
+      and (
+        map(select(.name == "require_app_store_eligible_build").run)
+        | first
+        | contains("APP_STORE_ELIGIBLE")
+      )
+  ' "$WORKFLOW"
+
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}

diff --git a/scripts/test/run-xcode-candidate.bats b/scripts/test/run-xcode-candidate.bats
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..98b2e59
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/test/run-xcode-candidate.bats
@@ -0,0 +1,98 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+
+bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
+
+setup() {
+  CANDIDATE="${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../run-xcode-candidate.sh"
+  REPO="$(mktemp -d)"
+  cd "$REPO"
+  git init -q -b main
+  git config user.email "test@example.com"
+  git config user.name "Test"
+  git config commit.gpgsign false
+  printf 'release\n' >README.md
+  git add README.md
+  git commit -qm release
+  TAG="v1.7.0"
+  git -c tag.gpgSign=false tag "$TAG"
+  SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
+
+  mkdir remote.git
+  git init -q --bare remote.git
+  git remote add origin "$REPO/remote.git"
+  git push -q origin main "refs/tags/${TAG}"
+
+  MOCK_BIN="$REPO/mock-bin"
+  mkdir "$MOCK_BIN"
+  CALLS="$REPO/asc-calls"
+  cat >"$MOCK_BIN/asc" <<'EOF'
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$ASC_CALLS"
+case "$*" in
+  'xcode-cloud workflows list '*)
+    printf '%s\n' '{"data":[{"id":"workflow-default","attributes":{"name":"Default"}}]}'
+    ;;
+  'xcode-cloud workflows repository '*)
+    printf '%s\n' '{"data":{"id":"repository-1"}}'
+    ;;
+  'xcode-cloud scm repositories git-references '*)
+    if [ "${ASC_MISSING_REF:-}" = '1' ]; then
+      printf '%s\n' '{"data":[]}'
+    else
+      printf '%s\n' '{"data":[{"id":"reference-1","attributes":{"canonicalName":"refs/tags/v1.7.0"}}]}'
+    fi
+    ;;
+  'xcode-cloud run '*)
+    printf '%s\n' '{"data":{"id":"run-1"}}'
+    ;;
+  *)
+    printf 'unexpected asc command: %s\n' "$*" >&2
+    exit 1
+    ;;
+esac
+EOF
+  chmod +x "$MOCK_BIN/asc"
+}
+
+teardown() {
+  cd /
+  rm -rf "$REPO"
+}
+
+@test "candidate: dry run pins a stable tag without calling Xcode Cloud" {
+  before_refs="$(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)')"
+
+  run env TAG="$TAG" UDO_RELEASE_DRY_RUN=1 "$CANDIDATE"
+
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"Default for ${TAG} (${SHA})"* ]]
+  [ "$(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)')" = "$before_refs" ]
+  [ ! -e "$CALLS" ]
+}
+
+@test "candidate: rejects prerelease tags" {
+  run env TAG='v1.7.0-next.1' UDO_RELEASE_DRY_RUN=1 "$CANDIDATE"
+
+  [ "$status" -eq 64 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"stable production tag"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "candidate: resolves Default and the exact tag reference without polling" {
+  run env TAG="$TAG" ASC_CALLS="$CALLS" PATH="$MOCK_BIN:$PATH" "$CANDIDATE"
+
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -q -- 'xcode-cloud workflows list --app 6760480210 --paginate' "$CALLS"
+  grep -q -- 'xcode-cloud workflows repository --id workflow-default' "$CALLS"
+  grep -q -- 'xcode-cloud scm repositories git-references --repo-id repository-1 --paginate' "$CALLS"
+  grep -q -- 'xcode-cloud run --workflow-id workflow-default --git-reference-id reference-1' "$CALLS"
+  ! grep -q -- '--wait' "$CALLS"
+}
+
+@test "candidate: fails closed when Xcode Cloud lacks the exact tag reference" {
+  run env TAG="$TAG" ASC_MISSING_REF=1 ASC_CALLS="$CALLS" PATH="$MOCK_BIN:$PATH" "$CANDIDATE"
+
+  [ "$status" -ne 0 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"no git reference for refs/tags/${TAG}"* ]]
+  ! grep -q -- 'xcode-cloud run ' "$CALLS"
+}
